header.subject: English
header.title: Chapter Vocabulary + Verb Impression Challenge (Memory Lane)
header.goal: Children use picture details to learn four verbs and record them.

moves.do: Ask three choral questions on verbs and the word bank.
moves.how: A verb tells what someone does.

moves.do: Show p.138; class says what they see in each picture.
moves.how: Ask: “When did you last gasp at home?” Class: “I see…”.
moves.say: “Today: use picture details to understand a verb.”

moves.do: Read the green box; model gasp with the picture.
moves.how: Class repeats each word. Write GASP and its meaning.
moves.say: “Gasp: a quick, sharp breath in shock.”
moves.think: I read the meaning, then I look: the red balloon is popping and his hand is near his mouth. Those details show gasp, so I write it.

moves.do: Read a meaning; class finds its picture and verb together.
moves.how: Gaze, scurry, sneer: which picture shows it?
moves.say: “To move hurriedly with short, quick steps. The verb is …” → “scurry!”

moves.do: Act a verb silently; neighbour names it and points to its picture.
moves.how: Act gaze, sneer, gasp or scurry, silent. Partner names it, points to the p.138 picture. Teacher checks 5 books.
moves.say: “Ayesha and Bilal show first. Safe actions.”

turn.a: (acts one verb, silent) My impression is ___.
turn.b: It is gasp. The clue is the hand near the mouth. (points)
turn.help: Act it again slowly; they say the verb.

moves.do: Write 4 words and meanings; 2. match each meaning, alone.
moves.how: 1. Word bank: 4 words. 2. Match (a)-(d). Done? Explain two pictures.
moves.say: “Read the meaning, then find its picture.”

answers: any safe impression; 4 words + meanings written
sections.mistake: Picks what sounds right. Ask: “Read the meaning, then find the picture detail.”
sections.stuck: See, Say, Show, Write: point to a picture, say and act the word. Start with gasp.

moves.do: Say two clues; five say the p.138 verb for each.
moves.how: (1) look steadily at the moon. (2) hurry to the bus on quick, short steps.
moves.say: “Think alone, then say the verb for each clue.”

sections.success: I can match each meaning to its verb.
sections.ask: How do you know the moon clue is gaze, not gasp?
sections.listen: Gaze is looking steadily; gasp is a quick breath in shock.

moves.do: Check spellings on p.138; add all four to the word bank.
moves.how: Write printed meanings, then one sentence with any word.
